### workspace wait-until-content --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace wait-until-content [project] "content" [options] [-- command...]

Poll a tmux pane's scrollback until it contains CONTENT,
then exec COMMAND in this process (it takes over the terminal:
direct Ctrl-C, untouched STDIN/STDOUT/STDERR).

Options:
        --name WS                    The project, as an option (same as the positional [project])
        --pane N                     Target pane: zero-based index, 'window.pane' (e.g. '0.1', as shown by 'workspace sessions'), a tmux pane id (e.g. '%19', from 'workspace sessions --json'), 'bottom', or a title substring (e.g. 'Claude Code'). A title is matched against the raw pane title, then the agent label shown in 'workspace sessions' TITLE; the first matching pane wins, so use 'window.pane' or a '%id' to be exact (default: bottom)
        --lines N                    Match against the last N lines of scrollback (default: 100)
        --interval SECONDS           Seconds between polls (default: 0.5)
        --max-wait-time SECONDS      Give up after this many seconds (default: wait forever)
        --since-start                Only match content written after this command starts
    -e, --exec CMD                   Shell command to exec on match (a command after -- takes precedence)

Examples:
  workspace wait-until-content "Listening on" -- open http://localhost:3000    # open the browser once the dev server is up, project auto-detected
  workspace wait-until-content scooter "Ready to accept" -- bin/console    # explicit project, bottommost pane
  workspace wait-until-content --name scooter "Ready to accept" -- bin/console    # a script keeps the project name apart from the text to match
  workspace wait-until-content scooter "Ready to accept" --pane 0 --max-wait-time 120 -- bin/console    # watch pane 0, give up (exit 1) after 2 minutes
  workspace wait-until-content scooter "WORKSPACE_DONE" --pane "Claude Code" -- irb    # watch the pane whose title matches
  workspace wait-until-content scooter "namespace is running" --since-start --max-wait-time 60 -- ./scripts/attach.sh    # ignore output already in the scrollback
  workspace wait-until-content scooter "READY" --lines 20 --interval 2 -- ./scripts/go.sh    # match the last 20 lines, poll every 2 seconds
  workspace wait-until-content scooter "READY" -e 'echo matched && open http://localhost:3000'    # run more than one command once it matches
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace wait-until-content
--- exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
Usage: workspace wait-until-content [project] "content" [options] [-- command...]

Poll a tmux pane's scrollback until it contains CONTENT,
then exec COMMAND in this process (it takes over the terminal:
direct Ctrl-C, untouched STDIN/STDOUT/STDERR).

Options:
        --name WS                    The project, as an option (same as the positional [project])
        --pane N                     Target pane: zero-based index, 'window.pane' (e.g. '0.1', as shown by 'workspace sessions'), a tmux pane id (e.g. '%19', from 'workspace sessions --json'), 'bottom', or a title substring (e.g. 'Claude Code'). A title is matched against the raw pane title, then the agent label shown in 'workspace sessions' TITLE; the first matching pane wins, so use 'window.pane' or a '%id' to be exact (default: bottom)
        --lines N                    Match against the last N lines of scrollback (default: 100)
        --interval SECONDS           Seconds between polls (default: 0.5)
        --max-wait-time SECONDS      Give up after this many seconds (default: wait forever)
        --since-start                Only match content written after this command starts
    -e, --exec CMD                   Shell command to exec on match (a command after -- takes precedence)

Examples:
  workspace wait-until-content "Listening on" -- open http://localhost:3000    # open the browser once the dev server is up, project auto-detected
  workspace wait-until-content scooter "Ready to accept" -- bin/console    # explicit project, bottommost pane
  workspace wait-until-content --name scooter "Ready to accept" -- bin/console    # a script keeps the project name apart from the text to match
  workspace wait-until-content scooter "Ready to accept" --pane 0 --max-wait-time 120 -- bin/console    # watch pane 0, give up (exit 1) after 2 minutes
  workspace wait-until-content scooter "WORKSPACE_DONE" --pane "Claude Code" -- irb    # watch the pane whose title matches
  workspace wait-until-content scooter "namespace is running" --since-start --max-wait-time 60 -- ./scripts/attach.sh    # ignore output already in the scrollback
  workspace wait-until-content scooter "READY" --lines 20 --interval 2 -- ./scripts/go.sh    # match the last 20 lines, poll every 2 seconds
  workspace wait-until-content scooter "READY" -e 'echo matched && open http://localhost:3000'    # run more than one command once it matches
--- end
